baseline_models.focus_anchor: `فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى` joins a singular imperative of entry to `فِى` and the possessed plural `عِبَٰدِى`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command moves the addressee across a boundary into a collective whose shared principle is submissive service to the speaker. Entry therefore changes location and affiliation at once.

activation_trace.role: Going inside supplies the boundary crossing and makes the imperative an admission rather than mere proximity.
Worship and submissive obedience supply the relation that constitutes the destination collective.

changed_reading.before: A command to go inside an unspecified place near some servants.
changed_reading.after: A command to cross into belonging among those constituted by service and obedience to the speaker.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The inward branch of `د خ ل` remains attached to the imperative, while `عِبَٰدِى` names the mode entered.
baseline_models.mechanism: Entry can be inward as well as spatial: the addressee is summoned to inhabit servanthood as an interior disposition that becomes socially visible through belonging among servants.

activation_trace.role: The hidden interior turns entry toward an inward state rather than limiting it to physical relocation.
Submissive worship names the inward orientation that the addressee is invited to inhabit.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is externally relocated among a group.
changed_reading.after: The addressee enters a lived interior condition of service whose outward form is membership among the servants.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `فِى عِبَٰدِى` can mark inclusion within a plural body, and the entry root carries images of an entrant mixing with a group and of interleaved parts.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command changes the addressee from an outsider into a constituent part of an existing servant body. Interleaving implies cohesion without requiring the entrant to disappear.

activation_trace.role: An entrant mixed into a group supplies the social transition from outsider to insider.
Interleaving parts supplies a model of close incorporation in which distinguishable parts form one body.
Shared obedient service provides the binding relation of the interleaved body.

changed_reading.before: The addressee merely stands beside a set of servants.
changed_reading.after: The addressee ceases to be an outsider and becomes an interleaved, still distinguishable member of their body.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessed noun `عِبَٰدِى` is capable of activating both owned status and the root's counter-image of being honored and magnified.
baseline_models.mechanism: The possessive invitation holds abasement and elevation together: entry into the speaker's servants is not simply degradation, because the same root inventory lets service coexist with being specially honored.

activation_trace.role: Literal entry makes the paradox a conferred status into which the addressee is admitted.
Owned or enslaved status supplies the lowering pole inherent in servant language.
Being honored and magnified supplies the unexpected elevating pole within the same root.

changed_reading.before: Entry into servanthood lowers the addressee into an owned class.
changed_reading.after: The speaker's possessive summons admits the addressee into a status where lowly service and special honor coexist.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence supplies emergence from night, completion, joining, lone oddness, and nocturnal passage. Against that sequence, the singular addressee entering the plural servants can be read as a lone unit completing its passage by being joined to a larger order.

activation_trace.role: Entry supplies the terminal crossing from solitary passage into a new inside.
The plural service relation supplies the shared order into which the singular unit is joined.
Dawn breaking out of night supplies emergence at the end of a dark interval.
Completion of nine by a tenth supplies the mechanism of an added member completing an order.
Joining a thing to its like supplies the move from isolated unit to associated plurality.
The lone member without a pair supplies the starting condition of the individually addressed self.
Night travel supplies the liminal passage that culminates in entry.

structural_cues: Packet order moves from dawn through ten nights and even/odd to a night in motion.
The command in 89:29 addresses one feminine addressee, while its destination is the possessed plural `عِبَادِي`.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completion, joining, lone oddness, and passage; I supply the arrow that maps those images onto the singular-to-plural grammar of 89:29. A live alternative is that the opening sequence marks time and oath structure without modeling this admission.

changed_reading.before: One individual simply joins an already existing group.
changed_reading.after: A lone self completes a liminal passage by being added into servant plurality, as the unpaired becomes joined and a sequence reaches fullness.

context_deltas.mechanism: External pillars and peg-like fixity belong to a transgressive, corrupt order that is eventually pounded level. The later straight ranks, together with the focus branches of interleaving and solidity, activate the servants as an alternative living architecture whose stability is relational rather than monumental.

activation_trace.role: Interleaving parts supplies the internal joints of the alternative collective structure.
Strength and solidity make the servant root capable of carrying durability rather than only submission.
Columns and supports supply the monumental model of stability that the reading later reverses.
Upright peg-like fixity intensifies the image of power secured by external supports.
Exceeding the limit in rebellion marks the monumental order as structurally misdirected.
Departure from soundness identifies the internal failure beneath apparent civic strength.
Pounding and demolition to level ground remove confidence in fixed material supports.
Alignment on a straight line supplies a non-monumental order of coordinated living members.

structural_cues: The historical block moves from pillars and pegs through transgression and corruption, while the judgment scene levels the earth and arrays living ranks.
The branchless `ك ي ف` in 89:6 functions only as the interrogative opening of the historical demonstration; no mapped root or branch is assigned to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed supports, leveling, alignment, interleaving, and servant-root solidity; I infer that the final collective replaces monumental architecture with a living one. The materially framed scenes may instead be only a judgment/salvation contrast, leaving the architectural transfer inactive.

changed_reading.before: Entry among the servants is a private reward detached from the ruined civilizations.
changed_reading.after: The addressee joins a living structure whose obedient, interleaved cohesion outlasts the pillars, pegs, and civic power of corrupt orders.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human claim that wealth is honor is exposed by failure to honor the cut-off orphan, mobilize food for the abased poor, and restrain totalizing consumption of inherited wealth. Entry among the speaker's servants is consequently revised from a generic devotional label into admission to a counter-community whose service repairs exclusion and reverses acquisitive incorporation.

activation_trace.role: An entrant mixed into a group makes the ethical reversal a concrete admission into a different social body.
Submissive service supplies the shared allegiance that displaces service to wealth.
Honor within the servant root reverses the preceding false equation of honor with possession.
Testing that reveals a condition turns prosperity into disclosure of social character rather than proof of favor.
Noble generosity supplies the honor that must be enacted toward another rather than merely claimed for oneself.
A child cut off from a caretaker supplies the social disconnection that the servant collective must repair.
Urging toward an act makes nourishment a collectively mobilized duty rather than private sentiment.
Feeding another supplies the outward service by which belonging becomes materially sustaining.
The abasement of poverty identifies the person whose low status tests the community's claimed honor.
Consuming and taking wealth supplies the rival mechanism that absorbs goods into the self.
Inheritance passing from predecessor to successor supplies the transferred goods vulnerable to predatory incorporation.
Gathering scattered things supplies the totalizing mode of consumption that contrasts with gathering persons into care.
Love fixed in the heart identifies the inward allegiance that competes with service to the speaker.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth names the object around which the failed social body organizes itself.

structural_cues: The corrective `كَلَّا بَل` in 89:17 overturns the human honor/humiliation inference before the plural social indictments of 89:17-20.
The repeated second-person plural failures precede the singular welcome into a differently possessed plural, `عِبَادِي`.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a test, false honor, neglected dependents, feeding, predatory consumption, and heart-level attachment to wealth; I infer that `My servants` names the counter-social body implied by those failures. A live alternative is that the ethical block states prerequisites for the addressee without defining the servant collective itself.

changed_reading.before: The servants are a generic devotional cohort distinguished only by worship.
changed_reading.after: They are also a counter-economy of service: a body that honors the cut-off, mobilizes nourishment, and gathers people rather than swallowing their goods.

context_deltas.mechanism: The servant root's owned-status branch could make entry sound like another bondage. The immediately preceding unparalleled punishment and physical fetter distinguish coercive restraint from the following servant relation, while the same fetter root's covenant branch keeps a non-coercive bond live.

activation_trace.role: Entry supplies movement out of the punitive frame and into a differently constituted bond.
Owned status exposes the danger that servanthood might be mistaken for the fetter just described.
Submissive worship supplies the alternative relation of allegiance rather than externally imposed restraint.
Painful punishment supplies the coercive environment from which the final invitation must be distinguished.
Exhaustive negation intensifies the singularly incomparable punitive action before the plural admission.
The binding strap supplies the literal coercive attachment that service is not simply repeating.
The confirmed covenant supplies a second mode of binding that can color servant allegiance without importing the fetter.

structural_cues: The parallel `no one` clauses of 89:25-26 are followed by a vocative to one self and then entry into the plural servants.
Punishment and binding are finite verbs imposed on an object, whereas 89:29 is an imperative invitation whose destination is a possessed community.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies punishment, physical binding, covenant, and the owned/service branches; I infer a contrast between coercive and covenantal attachment. The alternative is simple sequencing of two outcomes with no intended comparison between fetter and servanthood.

changed_reading.before: The command subjects the addressee to a new form of bondage.
changed_reading.after: The addressee leaves the frame of punitive fettering and enters a willing, covenant-like allegiance among the speaker's servants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The individually addressed self remains an essence in its own right, becomes tranquil, returns to a Lord characterized by nurture and completion, and is described through paired satisfaction. Entry then becomes interleaving without erasure and service under reciprocal approval rather than anonymous absorption.

activation_trace.role: Interleaving supplies incorporation that can preserve distinct parts within a coherent whole.
Obedient service supplies the addressee's active relation within the collective.
Being honored supplies the receiving side of a relation that does not erase the servant.
The thing itself and its essence keep the addressee individually intact before collective entry.
Stillness and tranquility make entry the continuation of settledness rather than a loss of self.
Return to what was supplies restoration and precedes incorporation.
Nurture, repair, and completion characterize the Lord to whom the self returns.
Mutual satisfaction supplies reciprocal acceptance immediately before entry.
The non-dominant mapped branch joins obedience, love, and guarantee, thickening the relation beyond passive approval.

structural_cues: The vocative singles out `the tranquil self`, then the feminine imperatives `return` and `enter` preserve that addressee across the transition.
The active/passive pair `رَاضِيَةً مَرْضِيَّةً` places satisfaction in two grammatical directions before collective admission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selfhood, tranquility, return, nurture, mutual satisfaction, and interleaving; I infer that these protect identity and make belonging reciprocal. A live alternative is that the two satisfaction forms state parallel one-way predicates rather than a negotiated mutual relation.

changed_reading.before: The individual dissolves anonymously into a servile mass.
changed_reading.after: An intact, tranquil self is interleaved into the servants through a relation of nurture, obedience, honor, and two-directional approval.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated entry imperative creates two ordered inclusions: first within the servants, then within the garden. The garden root's concealment and protective-cover branches make the servant collective readable as the first sheltering enclosure or social threshold of the second entry.

activation_trace.role: The first going-inside supplies the initial layer of the staged admission.
The servant collective supplies a relational interior before the garden interior.
The repeated going-inside supplies a second boundary crossing and makes sequence materially visible.
Concealment supplies the enclosing quality of the destination reached after social entry.
A garden hidden by trees supplies the concrete second interior.
A protective covering lets the prior servant entry function as fellowship and shelter, not merely protocol.

structural_cues: Adjacent verses repeat the same feminine entry command, first with `فِى عِبَٰدِى` and then with the direct destination `جَنَّتِى`.
The social destination is syntactically stated before the garden destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated entry, ordered complements, concealment, garden, and protection; I infer nested staging in which communal belonging is the first enclosure. The alternative is that the two imperatives are coordinated permissions with no threshold relation.

changed_reading.before: Entry among the servants is a parallel welcome beside entry into the garden.
changed_reading.after: Belonging among the servants is the first sheltering interior and social threshold through which the addressee proceeds into the garden.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a technical pastoral branch of `د خ ل` for a human imperative. It remains anchored in the focus root and is reinforced by return, rain-provision, life-sustaining water, and the following garden; downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for replenishing reinsertion, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus entry branch includes putting a thirsty camel back among others at a trough so that it can complete drinking; `فِى عِبَٰدِى` supplies the communal middle into which the addressee is reinserted.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thirsty animal back among others at water supplies the exact focus-root image of restorative communal reinsertion.
The servants supply the human collective that receives the pastoral image only by analogy.
Rain descending as provision supplies the wider water-as-gift field.
Water by which the self is sustained makes drinking an image of restored life rather than mere thirst.
Return to what was supplies the motion of being brought back before re-entry among others.
The tree-covered garden supplies the fertile destination beyond the replenishing communal entry.

changed_reading.before: The addressee receives an abstract spiritual admission.
changed_reading.after: The addressee is analogically reintroduced among a life-sharing company, like a thirsty being returned among others to complete its drink before entering fertile shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the crowd branch of `ج ن ن` is remote from the ordinary garden noun. It remains anchored by the adjacent repeated entry and by the focus images of interleaving and servant plurality; downstream prose should treat servants-as-garden and garden-as-host as a reversible image, never as lexical identity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus first places the addressee inside the possessed servants; the next verse repeats entry into a root inventory that includes both a hidden garden and a gathered mass of people.

activation_trace.role: Interleaving parts lets the servants appear as an enclosing human medium rather than a mere list of individuals.
Shared service keeps the human enclosure anchored in the actual possessed plural.
Repeated entry binds the two destinations closely enough for their images to overlap.
The hidden garden supplies the normal destination image that colors the servant collective.
A mass or gathering of people supplies the reverse image by which the garden can resemble a gathered host.

changed_reading.before: Servants and garden are two wholly separate destinations.
changed_reading.after: The adjacent entries briefly overlap: the servants become a garden-like human enclosure, while the garden can appear as a gathered host.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because scattering in different directions belongs to a branch-distant derivative of `ع ب د`, not the ordinary sense of `عِبَاد`. It remains focus-anchored through that exact root branch and through the entry/interleaving construction, with joining, gathering, and rows as context support; downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial-social resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The possessed plural `عِبَٰدِى` can faintly retain the root's image of scattered groups or routes, while `فَٱدْخُلِى فِى` supplies their reassembly as a traversed and joined collective.

activation_trace.role: An entrant mixing with a group supplies the act by which a dispersed member becomes socially reassembled.
Interleaving supplies the resulting coherence without flattening the different routes into sameness.
Scattered groups and routes supply the surprising latent starting image within the servant root.
Joining a thing to its like supplies the first movement from dispersion toward association.
Gathering scattered parts supplies the direct reversal of the servant root's dispersed routes.
Straight rows supply an ordered plurality that can receive formerly scattered paths.

changed_reading.before: The servants form a homogeneous group already gathered in one place.
changed_reading.after: The invitation gathers a self into an ordered but internally varied assembly, as scattered servant-routes are joined without losing their distinct lines.

strongest_changes: The singular addressee's entry becomes a completion from lone passage into servant plurality.
The social critique revises `My servants` into a counter-community that honors the cut-off and feeds rather than consumes.
The tranquil self remains intact inside reciprocal, nurturing belonging rather than dissolving into an anonymous mass.
The repeated entry of 89:30 makes admission among the servants the first sheltering enclosure before the garden.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots hold unusually productive tensions: entry can be inward, social, interleaving, or restorative, while servanthood can carry ownership, worship, honor, solidity, and even dispersion. Context activates these into several coexisting mechanisms rather than resolving them to one sense.
remaining_uncertainties: The early completion and even/odd sequence may resonate with singular-to-plural admission without intentionally modeling it.
The paired satisfaction forms may express mutuality, or only two parallel directions of approval.
The two entry commands may be nested stages, or coordinated welcomes without a threshold relation.
Pastoral watering, living architecture, crowd-garden overlap, and scattered-route imagery should remain analogical because their branches are distant from the ordinary surface senses.
